description: The BBC Micro model A, bare: a program loaded between PAGE and HIMEM in MODE 7 that calls the MOS and does not return to BASIC.

reserved.why: the MOS's VDU, cassette and keyboard workspace
the MOS's sound, printer and RS-423 buffers, its soft keys and characters, and the NMI routine
the model A's 16K again, which answers twice, so a write here changes the byte $4000 lower
the paged ROMs: BASIC, and the DFS on the model B
the I/O pages FRED, JIM and SHEILA
the MOS's ROM: its entry points and vectors
